daily_summary: 当日变更主要围绕四个方向：(1) vLLM 上游 main 分支兼容性适配（bf016a1bc），对 Platform/分布式/算子层多处 API 变更做版本门控；(2) MoE 与序列并行重构修复（97f72b814、4ac4860d4），前者将共享专家执行拆分为独立 executor，后者修复 SP pass 对 MoE/dense 模型的模式匹配与通信路径选择；(3) 推理性能优化（fd9298242、d8777045c），分别优化 MiniMax M3 索引器 TP 分片和 MLAPO 算子的非连续 cache/量化支持；(4) MRV2 功能增强（d34185b4a、86859eb49），MTP 支持 FullGraph 图模式并修复 dummy input token 分布；另有大量 CI/文档清理（e8f25e304 删除外部启动器测试、b65303adc/6d3bed3d/281dcfa8a CI 增强、546f37e8b/c511ca4a9/36104e13b 文档）。整体节奏是持续跟随上游 + 性能优化 + 测试看护。
test_impact_summary: 当日测试策略呈现两个特点：一是跟随上游 API 变化同步更新测试（bf016a1bc 更新 IPC 权重传输 E2E/单测和结构化输出异常类型断言，f6ba5ed5 适配 KV Cache Manager 3 元组返回），二是增强算子/编译层测试密度（d8777045c 将 mla_preprocess 测试从 2 个参数组合扩展到 10 组 cache/quant 组合 + 非连续布局对比 + logical shape 接受；4ac4860d4 增加 maybe_all_reduce 模式替换的 SP 测试；97f72b814 更新 FusedMoE 重构后的 forward 契约测试）。同时也有测试清理（e8f25e304 删除 RL 外部启动器相关 E2E）和功能测试升级（d34185b4a 将 MTP 测试从 eager-only 升级为 graph 模式参数化）。风险点是版本门控代码（vllm_version_is）的测试覆盖需要持续跟进 vllm main 的新 API，以及新增的 Triton kernel 与自定义算子缺少更高频的精度回归测试。

[Core][BugFix][Test] Fix sequence parallelism for both MoE and dense model (#12772)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
#### Motivation
Fix #12760
The current SP implementation has the following issues:

- Dense models may ignore the configured `sp_min_token_num`, causing the
SP pass to be incorrectly marked as not applicable.
- MoE output graphs containing `maybe_all_reduce -> alias ->
maybe_chunk_residual -> RMSNorm` are not fully matched by the SP pass.
- Local residuals and full-sequence tensors can have inconsistent token
dimensions after SP communication.
- Enabling the SP compilation pass may incorrectly select the MoE EP
communication path and cause duplicated all-gather operations.

These issues can lead to SP not taking effect, graph replacement
failures, or runtime shape errors.

#### Changes
1. change SequenceParallelismPass pattern
2. Avoid selecting the MoE EP path unless native MoE sequence
parallelism is enabled.

commits.message:
[Performance][MiniMax M3] Optimize index score kernel and TP communication (#13142)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR improves MiniMax M3 indexer decode performance:

- Shards decode score computation across sequence blocks for
tensor-parallel execution.
- Exchanges index queries and local top-k candidates instead of
communicating the full index KV data.
- Merges per-rank scores and indices to produce the global top-k result.
- Reworks the Triton decode score kernel to handle init, local, normal,
partial, and padded blocks in one launch.
- Selects the decode chunk count based on the detected Ascend AI Core
count, with a bounded fallback policy.
- Removes redundant mask preparation and score-tail filling kernels.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This is an internal performance optimization and does not change
public APIs or configuration interfaces.

### How was this patch tested?

- Accuracy Test: gpqa-diamond 93.43 (temperature 0.6 top_p: 0.95)
aime25: 96.67 (temperature 1.0 top_p: 0.95)
- Performance Test:  (Align tpot 50ms)
before opt: 

| case | tpot (avg) | ttft(avg) | output_token_throught |

[MRV2][BugFix] Fix token distribution in make_dummy for AscendInputBatch (#13123)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR aligns the dummy input generation logic in
`AscendInputBatch.make_dummy` with the upstream vLLM implementation.
Previously, any remaining tokens (`num_tokens % num_reqs`) were
accumulated entirely onto the last request. This PR distributes the
extra tokens evenly across the last `num_extra` requests, ensuring that
each request receives either `base_tokens` or `base_tokens + 1` tokens.
[49751](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49751)

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

CI passed with existing tests.

[BugFix][Scheduler] Adapt BalanceScheduler to get_computed_blocks 3-tuple (#13275)

## Based on

This PR is based on
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13235 and re-submits
the same production-code change on an independent branch. No additional
functional changes are included.

## Why

The copied `BalanceScheduler.schedule()` implementation still expects
two return values from `KVCacheManager.get_computed_blocks()`. After the
upstream vLLM API change, the method returns three values, causing the
balance-scheduling path to fail at runtime.

## Upstream change

Upstream PR: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47782

The upstream change extends `get_computed_blocks()` to return:

```python
(computed_blocks, num_computed_tokens, shared_prefix_boundary)
```

## Downstream changes

- Update `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_balance_schedule.py` to
unpack the third value into `request.shared_prefix_boundary`.

## Test plan

- Full validation is delegated to PR CI.

## User-facing change

No.

[CI]Fix the bug in extracting modified test case information from the PR.  (#13206)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
This PR fixes the logic for extracting test cases from the PR. The
current implementation has two problems:

The regex pattern used to identify test cases does not require a test_
prefix, resulting in non-test files being incorrectly selected.

The logic compares extracted test cases against existing ones, causing
test cases with duplicate names to be filtered out.
### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No. This PR does not introduce any user-facing changes.

All changes are internal improvements to the test case extraction logic:
Removing coverage data comparison parameters
Adding test_ prefix check to regex patterns

These changes only affect the internal processing of test cases, and do
not alter any user-facing APIs, interfaces, or behaviors.
### How was this patch tested?
The following scenarios have been manually verified:
Non-test files are correctly excluded by the test_ prefix validation in
the regex
Test cases modified in the PR are correctly included in the execution
list by default
Test cases with duplicate names are no longer incorrectly filtered out

commits.message:
[Feature][MRV2] Support FullGraph for MTP in MRV2 (#13027)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR extends the Ascend MTP speculator to the MLA draft model in MRV2
to support the graph mode (FULL_DECODE_ONLY).

Combine MLA-specific rewriting with `attn_architecture ` to decouple the
logic of non-MLA models from MLA models:
a. ` _init_decode_draft_attn_metadatas` — rebuilds a padded graph-batch
base through the MLA builder so `.decode` is populated for every step.
After the draft prefill step, the live `model_state.attn_metadata.decode
`is either None or describes the live (unpadded) batch rather than the
padded graph batch being replayed, so it cannot be reused. The rebuild
constructs a decode-shaped metadata` (1 token/req → num_decodes > 0 →
.decode built)` from the current graph-batch buffers, sets the
step-invariant `actual_seq_lengths_q` once, and gives each step its own
`.decode` (copied per step) so per-step `seq_lens_list` writes do not
alias across steps.
b. `_update_decode_attn_metadata` — advances `.decode.seq_lens_list` per
step, the only field that changes per decode step (each request's
sequence length grows by one per draft token). The per-step `.decode`
ownership established in (a) lets each step advance independently
without overwriting other steps.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No

commits.message:
[Feature] Support MLAPO cache with non-contiguous tensors and add quant mode 1 (#12830)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Enhance Ascend fused `mla_preprocess` for MLA / DeepSeek-style serving:

1. **Dim0-noncontiguous KV cache writeback**  
In PagedAttention / FIA pools, logical shape stays `[blockNum,
blockSize, ...]`, but physical storage often stretches only **dim0**
(`stride(0) = N * product(shape[1:])`) while dims `1..N-1` remain
contiguous. The old kernel used a dense `slot * innerSize` formula and
could write into the wrong rows / holes.
This PR passes `kvCacheBlockSize` / `kvCacheStride0` /
`kvCacheRopeStride0` from the Torch tensor into tiling, and updates
ND/NZ cache addressing to:
   - ND: `blockIdx * stride0 + blockOffset * innerSize`
- NZ: `blockIdx * stride0 + blockOffset * C0` (with dynamic NZ
`dstStride`)

2. **BF16 `per_token_quant_symm` (quant mode = 1)**  
Add Host/Kernel dispatch for BF16 qm1 on cache modes `0/1/2/3`
(including `enable_inner_out`), so fused preprocess can emit per-token
symmetric int8 Q/KV paths used by quantized MLA serving.

3. **NZ rope dim fix + mode map cleanup**  
- Derive NZ rope dim via `GetRopeHeadDim` (physical NZ `[B, C1, Bs, C0]`
→ `C1*C0`, not last-axis C0=16).
   - Explicitly map `"kvcache" -> 0`.  
   - Reject non-BF16 qm1 at Host with a clear `TORCH_CHECK`.

Why: without (1), noncontiguous physical KV pools are incorrect; without
(2), BF16 per-token symmetric quant cannot take the fused Ascend path.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes, **behavior-only** (no new CLI / public Python API):

- Existing `torch.ops._C_ascend.mla_preprocess` callers with
**dim0-noncontiguous** `kv_cache` / `kv_cache_rope` now write the
correct physical slots (dims `1..` must stay contiguous; Host validates
this).
- BF16 + `quant_mode="per_token_quant_symm"` is newly runnable for cache
modes `kvcache` / `krope_ctkv` / `int8_nzcache` / `nzcache`.
- Contiguous layouts and previous quant modes keep the same call
surface; FP16 qm1 remains unsupported and fails fast at Host.

### How was this patch tested?

On Ascend 910B3 (CANN 9.1), against CPU/NPU golden and hole checks for
dim0-strided views:

1. **Regression / noncontiguous precision (existing qm0 paths)**  
200-case matrix (BF16/FP16 × contiguous + `nc_dim0_x{2,3,4}`): **200/200
passed**; holes in backing storage stay untouched.

2. **New BF16 qm1 path**  
- Smoke: contiguous / noncontiguous / inner-out for `krope_ctkv` +
`per_token_quant_symm`: passed.
- Generalized cm1 (`krope_ctkv`) / cm2 (`int8_nzcache`) matrices:
contiguous vs dim0-noncontiguous results match within supported shapes;
NZ int8 + hole checks OK for cm2 after key `266/778` + `GetRopeHeadDim`.

3. **Performance (msprof)**  
- Dim0-noncontiguous view: no material extra overhead vs contiguous on
the same path.
- New qm1 absolute latency recorded on DeepSeek-V3-like shapes (baseline
had no qm1).
- Existing BF16 qm0 continuous path: small kernel-time movement observed
in A/B; FP16 path no clear regression.

4. **Repo tests**  
   Existing e2e ops tests remain applicable:  

`tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/test_mla_preprocess*.py`

commits.comment: 该 commit 修复了 EC Connector 在 ec_both 角色下启动失败的问题。NPUModelRunner（v1 model runner）的 execute_model 和 get_kv_cache_spec 中将原来的 `has_ec_transfer() and get_ec_transfer().is_producer` 判断改为 `has_ec_transfer() and not get_ec_transfer().is_consumer`，与上游 vLLM 的语义对齐。变更后：纯 producer 角色仍会进入数据 dump 分支并在 get_kv_cache_spec 中返回空 KV cache spec；而 ec_both 角色不再被当作纯 producer 处理，get_kv_cache_spec 会返回真实的 KV cache 规格，避免 KV cache 分配被错误跳过，从而解决启动失败。改动仅影响启用 EC transfer 的场景，未启用时 has_ec_transfer() 短路返回 False，行为不变。风险较低，但需要确认 ec_both 下 connector 输入输出生命周期与上游实现完全一致。
